title: Grid
slide_intent: Teach designers to relate margins to internal spacing so the outer edge reads as a boundary and the spaces inside it organize information.
strategic_value: Instacart can retain a consistent rhythm across layouts by starting from one repeatable spacing relationship.
demonstration: A landscape frame holds six rows of six pale blue cells. The gutter is labeled x, and the top and left margins are labeled 2x.
practical_value: Set up the starting grid with six columns and six rows, then set the margins to twice the gutter.

content_islands.name: Grid instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and spacing rule in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Measured grid
content_islands.spec: Fill the wider right field with 36 blue cells separated by white gutters. Dimension the first gutter and both outer margins at the upper left.
